name: nc/post-meta
title: Post meta
description: Date, author, categories and custom taxonomy terms of the current post. Dynamic: read on every request.
aiHints: Show only the fields useful to the reader. The date goes in a time element. Use tax:<taxonomy> to show the terms of a custom taxonomy; set terms to chips to show them as chips instead of a comma list. Its parts for style.parts are item, term and link, for example style.parts.term.fontWeight 600.
